completion_policy: All done_when conditions and referenced test evidence must pass; blockers never become passes. Proceed to ready work on independent lanes.

tasks.title: Baseline, source preservation and scope ledger
steps: Read repository instructions, current branch, open PRs and package scripts; record the actual starting SHA and dirty/untracked changes without discarding them.
Install this packet under docs/void-handoff/. Preserve the reference snapshots. Reconcile any newer code by requirement ID; do not replay a migration over completed work.
Run the existing build/test commands with time limits; record failures honestly. Correct README claims so architecture declarations are not called implemented features.
Replace clip-ID-prefix scene membership with explicit sceneId/trackId relationships when migrating the SessionView; add a collision regression test.
done_when: Starting SHA, environment and observed checks recorded. Every original feature is present in FEATURE_TRACEABILITY.json. Existing source/history is preserved.
tasks.evidence: packet installed, baseline recorded, SessionView sceneId fix + vitest 3/3

tasks.title: Dependency rights and compatible version qualification
steps: Review the exact Tracktion/JUCE pair and upstream example builds; use C++20 where required by the selected engine, not an invented SDK API.
Pin exact engine/JUCE/submodule/toolchain/SDK revisions, feature flags, licences and source hashes. Start with the engine-supplied compatible JUCE revision.
Record a valid development-use path and a separate distribution-rights state. Do not buy licences, relicense the repository or publish binaries automatically.
Review advisory status including the actual linked SQLite build. Keep optional and evaluation libraries out of the initial installer.
done_when: Dependency compatibility evidence exists; development may proceed only within recorded permitted use. Distribution stays blocked while rights/signing/content approval is unknown.
tasks.evidence: PINS.md + QUALIFICATION.md; TE e760754+JUCE 37c894f; upstream suite 450/22282 exit 0

tasks.title: Tauri shell and supervised native worker
steps: Add the Tauri target beside the existing Electron entrypoint until F1 cutover; reuse UI tokens where useful, not the stub audio backend.
Build a C++ worker using the selected JUCE message loop and engine examples. Rust supervises worker identity, startup readiness, heartbeat, bounded restart and graceful shutdown.

Create a restrictive local control channel using Unix-domain sockets or named pipes; use per-launch secrets/inherited handles, peer checks and scoped permissions. No public or unauthenticated loopback API.
Keep a WebView reload distinct from closing the application. Confirm all child processes terminate after an intentional app exit.
done_when: A real Rust shell starts, handshakes with and stops the C++ process. Renderer restart preserves the worker; engine restart produces a new epoch and explicit stopped/recovery state.
tasks.evidence: Tauri v2 shell + void-worker supervisor + mock worker; wire_roundtrip green; tauri build -> deb/rpm/AppImage

tasks.title: Command protocol, object IDs and bounded state views
steps: Implement CONTRACTS.md and validate schemas. Generate compatible Rust/C++ FlatBuffers bindings and typed frontend DTOs; do not pass unvalidated JSON through to engine APIs.
Serialize document mutation off the audio callback; carry commandId/projectId/expectedRevision/engineEpoch and stable object IDs.
Implement duplicate-ID receipts, payload-hash conflict rejection, revision conflicts, paginated/viewport reads and snapshot-plus-delta reattachment.
Use bounded control queues and lossy meter telemetry. Clock, recordings and audio buffers must not travel through WebView events.
done_when: Malformed, duplicate, stale and out-of-scope requests have deterministic outcomes; frontend state reattaches without loading the whole project.
tasks.evidence: void_control.fbs frozen 1.0; 32 ops; ControlEnvelope; receipt/dedup/revision stores; codec full coverage

tasks.title: Tracktion musical model, device path and native playback
steps: Instantiate one authoritative engine Edit and device manager. Map project/track/clip/note/parameter IDs with saved metadata; never derive relationships from ID prefixes.
Implement create project, import approved WAV, add audio/MIDI/instrument track, note insertion and transport start/stop/seek/cycle using actual engine APIs.
Run graph preparation, asset I/O and disposal off the audio callback. Use engine scheduling and latency facilities before inventing alternatives.
Build an offline render test fixture and real native output playback. A generated test tone is a test asset, not simulated user audio.
done_when: Fixture playback/render works through the native graph. UI values change audible native parameters, not only local component state.
tasks.evidence: native/void-engine live wire 15/15 harness; T13/T15/T16 need audio device/GUI

tasks.title: Immutable assets and crash-consistent checkpoints
steps: Implement the project container, content-hashed media, complete checkpoint manifest and CURRENT pointer defined in CONTRACTS.md.
Capture engine state, app metadata and coordinated revision at a serialized mutation barrier while audio continues. Write, flush, verify and atomically publish a complete checkpoint.
Make the checkpoint manifest the save authority; SQLite is a reconstructable index for committed checkpoints and a transactional store for app jobs. Do not claim a transaction spanning DB and files.
Retain previous verified checkpoints, recover uncertain commands safely and migrate older project schemas by copy-on-write. Refuse overwrite of newer unsupported formats.
done_when: Crash/disk-full at every save boundary never destroys the last committed project. Save success means a complete verified published checkpoint, not queued writes.

tasks.title: Native plugin proof and safe scanning
steps: Run discovery/scan in a short-lived process with timeout and quarantine. Cache exact plugin binary/version/architecture identity.
Load one known legally usable VST3 fixture and exercise its native editor and state; test AU separately on macOS. Start with engine-hosted processing, clearly labeled not isolated.
Test editor open/close, resize, focus, DPI, keyboard and project-close teardown. Preserve unknown/missing plugin state blobs for later restoration.
Provoke scan hang and engine/plugin crash. Distinguish scanner failure, engine failure and future isolated runtime failure.
done_when: Native plugin processing and native editor actually work on the first tested OS; other OS rows remain unverified until tested. Engine failure stops audio but leaves the Rust shell able to recover.
tasks.evidence: void-plugin-scanner AU+selftest isolation; T23 foreign-arch blocked

tasks.title: CI, diagnostics, clean install and Foundation gate
steps: Build on native OS runners with pinned toolchains, job timeouts, bounded matrix concurrency and cancellation of superseded branch runs.
Add structured redacted logs, callback/dropout counters and process-tree resource snapshots. Keep instrumentation that allocates out of real-time release callbacks.
Test release-like installation without a development toolchain. Use OS signing/notarization when credentials exist; unsigned internal builds must be labeled and cannot pass signed-release checks.
Prove UI reload + real plugin + save/reopen + offline render. Publish F0 evidence per platform; retain the Electron path until F1 is accepted.
done_when: F0 software gate passes with exact commands and artifacts. Hardware/signing rows are passed only with real evidence, otherwise explicitly blocked; next nondependent work may continue.
tasks.evidence: ci.yml + doctor.sh (8/2/0) + EVIDENCE.md; install path pending native binary on non-mac

tasks.title: Audio/MIDI recording and monitoring workflow
steps: Implement input/output setup, arm, monitoring mode, count-in, metronome, cycle/punch boundaries and mono/stereo multitrack recording.
Capture MIDI with timestamps, sustain/bend/aftertouch, latency alignment and MIDI import/export/demix. Add all-notes-off on disconnect, stop and panic.
Write growing recordings into a recoverable recording journal with persisted chunk lengths; incomplete takes are recovered and labeled, not mistaken for final assets.
Handle denied microphone permission, device loss, rate/buffer mismatch, full disk and changing default devices without surprise feedback or false recording success.
done_when: A person can record voice and MIDI offline, hear the intended monitoring path and recover a partial take after an induced failure. Hardware latency is measured, not inferred from buffer size.
tasks.evidence: RecordingManager+MidiCapture+TakeJournal merged; take 20/20, errors 8/8, kill-recovery labels incomplete, panic allNotesOff=16, hosted roundTrip 2.729ms; blocked: real HW latency headless + protocol has no recording ops (NEEDS.md §7-8 proposes rev2 ops)

tasks.title: Arrangement and piano-roll editors
steps: Create Compose/Arrange/Mix workspaces with consistent transport and track selection. No approved Figma file exists in this packet: build a functional original UI, not a fictitious design match.
Implement virtualized tracks, multiresolution waveform tiles, region select/move/trim/split/duplicate, snapping and explicit scene/track slots.
Implement piano-roll pitch/start/duration/velocity edits and CC lanes with pointer and keyboard controls; group a drag into one history transaction.
Keep viewport caches bounded and reconcile optimistic feedback with authoritative acknowledgements. Implement focus, range semantics, reduced motion and empty/error states.
done_when: Edits change real audio/MIDI, survive save/reopen and have coherent undo. Large arrangements do not clone all sample data into JavaScript.

tasks.title: Playable instruments, real mixer and export
steps: Expose engine starter synth/sampler and utility processors with original/cleared presets; use existing DSP and approved sample assets.
Implement gain/pan/mute/solo, real meters, insert/bypass and channel presets; use safe monitoring defaults and display actual clipping.
Implement mono/stereo WAV and MIDI export with selected range, sample rate, bit depth, tails and a progress/cancel/failure flow.
Keep renders on an immutable checkpoint/snapshot; edits after render start do not silently change the output. Stage files and publish only completed results.

tasks.title: First-song qualification and Electron cutover
steps: Run the full first-song journey and all failure-path tests on supported targets. Measure 30-minute workloads using the fixture and hardware policy.
Add templates, recent projects, project/track notes, relink recovery, help/onboarding and localizable copy.

Remove Electron packaging/default startup and WebAudio production routing only after native equivalence for implemented workflows is demonstrated. Preserve git history and any legacy project importer that is actually needed.

tasks.title: AI job runtime, budgets and provenance
steps: Implement job state machine, bounded queue, reservation-based RAM/VRAM/CPU admission, progress, deadlines, cancellation and orphan cleanup.
Add signed model manifests, version/hash checks, optional downloads, inspectable project-scoped memory and deletion/retention rules.
Integrate one qualified compact runtime/model first; bundle a locked worker runtime rather than requiring users to install Python.
No hidden cloud fallback, raw private-project telemetry, arbitrary shell tool or automatic training. Store permitted inputs, model/runtime revision, settings and accepted-output provenance.

tasks.title: Predictive composition and safe proposal transactions
steps: Start with deterministic scale/chord/rhythm rules and optionally a compact qualified model; expose ghost notes and several candidates inside the piano roll/pads.
Use a scoped context digest of notes, chords, meter, key, selected bars, locked regions and instrument; never send the whole song by default.
Audition in a transient engine layer excluded from persistent snapshots. Support partial accept, reject, regenerate, editable accepted notes and one-step undo.
Reject or explicitly revalidate stale results; never let project lyrics, filenames or model outputs escalate permissions or execute arbitrary code.
done_when: A user can compose with manual notes, audition a continuation, accept part of it, undo and reopen the original state; candidates do not become saved edits until accepted.

Add step patterns, quick sample slicing, drum pads, loop browser, chord track/harmonic constraints and explicitly armed MIDI-learn/macros.

Keep camera optional for F4 and advanced MIDI/MPE depth in F3; do not make camera access a prerequisite to gesture composition.

steps: Add loop takes, comping, overdub/replace, step input, repeat and bounded recent-MIDI/audio capture with explicit retention.
Add project/track alternatives, region loops/aliases/folders, fades/crossfades, silence removal, stacks/groups, global sections and protected edits.

steps: Expose sends/aux/VCA/groups/multi-output/external I-O, delay compensation and channel-layout validation.
Add read/touch/latch/write automation, trim/relative edits, move-with-region semantics and audible A-B with shared undo.

tasks.title: Stock sound library, effects and time/pitch tools
steps: Build curated effect and instrument coverage using the named stock inventory as musical outcomes, not Apple branding or copied presets.
Use selected stretch DSP; implement transient markers, varispeed, repair, note-level pitch UI, correction/shifting and render-tail handling.
Add streaming multisamples/zones/round robins, user patches, sampler capture and downloadable cleared packs. Evaluate deeper synthesis separately for F5.
Validate six-stem separation separately from four-stem candidates, drum replacement/transcription, metering/loudness and automated-mastering review.

tasks.title: Plugin compatibility, optional isolation and exchange
steps: Qualify AUv2/AUv3 and VST3 on supported systems. Add a real CLAP host only when selected; do not confuse exporter support with hosting.

Implement processing isolation as its own feature using bounded native buffers, deadlines, mute/bypass fallback, bridge-latency accounting and safe restart. Process separation is not a complete OS sandbox.
Build declarative supported-format import/export and loss reports, including DAWproject if selected; retain audio stems/MIDI interchange.
Preserve missing plugin state and compatibility registry; never promise native .logicx round trips or AAX hosting.

tasks.title: Accompaniment, arrangement and producer gate
steps: Add inspectable drum/bass/keyboard/synth accompaniment, arrangement/orchestration proposals, inpainting/continuation and variations with protected source regions.
Add analysis-led mastering proposals with meters, audition and explicit acceptance; do not call a loudness meter a mastering assistant.
Complete advanced export/stem batches, custom shortcuts/screensets, consolidation/project import and producer regression coverage.
done_when: F3 producer journeys pass with loss reports and measured compatibility. Every original feature is complete, explicitly blocked or scheduled—not silently removed.

tasks.title: Conventional native visual composition and program output
steps: Use a separate native wgpu output window first, with optional preview copies; do not require unproven zero-copy WebView embedding.
Implement normal images/video/presets, layers/transforms/blends, transitions, beat/sample/timecode anchors, preview/program distinction and multi-display selection.
Use audio-clock snapshots and calibrated presentation latency. Drop visual frames under load; audio never waits on GPU or decoder work.
Implement joint audio/visual checkpoint/history semantics using the transaction protocol; model independent output and preview failure states.
done_when: An imported visual sequence follows a saved song through edit/reopen/output; renderer crash and slow frames do not block the native audio callback.

tasks.title: Generated/reactive visuals and optional camera conducting
steps: Add approved visual-generation jobs as normal assets. Prefer declarative scene parameters to arbitrary generated code.
Add audio-feature mappings and validated shader presets; generated shaders compile off playback with resource/time limits, watchdog and known-good fallback.
Evaluate projectM as a distinct OpenGL path with its own rights and compositing/export tests; do not force it into wgpu without proof.
Optional local camera landmarks require consent, calibration, clutch, confidence threshold, smoothing and loss-triggered note release.
done_when: AI/visual/camera failures leave editable musical state intact; generated material requires explicit acceptance and tracking loss never produces stuck notes.

tasks.title: Audiovisual export and visual qualification gate
steps: Integrate an approved FFmpeg build/codec matrix with argv-only subprocess execution, restricted inputs and bounded resources.
Render from an immutable checkpoint with exact rational video frame rate and audio sample time; handle fractional frame rates, tails and explicit duration.
Persist source/model/render configuration and characterize nondeterministic output rather than promising bit-identical model or GPU rerenders.
Test visual-worker/GPU/export failure, absent codec, disk full, timeouts and update blocking during performance.
done_when: Conventional and generated visuals export in sync with the reference audio, with correct duration and explicit errors. F4 claims match tested GPU/codec paths.

tasks.title: Notation, scoring and advanced interchange
steps: Integrate qualified score engraving such as Verovio; implement actual selection/edit/parts/lyrics/tab workflows over stable musical IDs.
Add movie scoring with absolute-time anchors, declared timecode modes and loss-aware MusicXML/AAF/Final Cut interchange.
Qualify Logic/GarageBand migration only for formats/specifications lawfully supported; provide stems/MIDI alternatives and explicit unsupported-feature reports.
done_when: Notation edits round-trip to musical events and supported export fixtures pass; no implied complete proprietary project conversion.

tasks.title: Spatial routing and delivery
steps: Implement tested multichannel/surround and binaural paths, speaker/object metadata and clear monitoring configuration.
Gate Atmos/ADM BWF/MP4/head-tracking work on actual specifications, licensed dependencies and reference validators. Do not use a generic stereo export as a proxy.
Make unsupported outputs unavailable with a reason. Continue other F5 work when licensing or hardware blocks this lane.
done_when: Every enabled spatial deliverable validates externally and on declared playback hardware; blocked commercial/specification requirements remain open.

tasks.title: Synchronization, modular control and safe shows
steps: Add MTC/MIDI Clock/MMC and qualified Ableton Link with explicit tempo-master rules and measured latency.
Add projection mapping, cue/rehearsal workflow and scoped OSC/DMX transport. Physical output requires pairing, arming, profiles and independent manual panic/blackout.
Implement Environment-style MIDI/modular mappings and optional companion/control-surface contracts without putting accounts/cloud on the playback path.
Do not permit generated instructions to directly actuate stage hardware; strobe limits and safe-disconnect behavior are explicit controls.
done_when: Sync and show fixtures pass on declared devices; manual stop/blackout and disconnect override generated/queued actions.

tasks.title: Advanced synthesis and restricted extensions
steps: Cover advanced synthesis/resynthesis/physical-modelling outcomes using selected maintained integrations, with independent content and API reviews.
Add restricted WASM/declarative modules with explicit capabilities, fuel/memory limits, cancellation and no ambient filesystem/network. Start outside the critical audio path.
Gate native plugin export and ARA on confirmed SDK rights/compatibility. Do not turn the runtime into an unrestricted code agent.
Bring forward the original WASM feature IDs; their implementation is deliberately deferred from the older F4 plan into this hardened F5 lane.
done_when: Enabled extension/instrument workflows have load/save, limits, recovery and rights evidence; unsupported code/plugin-export features are not falsely marked shipped.

tasks.title: Full parity reconciliation and release readiness
steps: Reconcile all 116 features, 22 stock groups, 41 dependency decisions, 20 infrastructure requirements and every test against exact commits and evidence.
Separate complete outcomes from partial, blocked, deferred-by-approval and unsupported interoperability. No blanket Logic-equivalence claim.
Run clean-machine installation/update/recovery and full musician workflows across supported platforms. Audit runtime contents, model/content rights and privacy.
Prepare a release candidate and incident/rollback playbook; public release, store submission, licence purchase and scope removal still require explicit authorization.
done_when: Release report includes supported feature/device matrix, residual risks and reproducible evidence. Any unresolved requirement prevents a full-parity completion claim, not unrelated work.

dependency_semantics.default: A prerequisite is satisfied by complete, or documented development_ready on the same tested target where only explicitly recorded external qualification gates remain. It is not satisfied by blocked, a mock, a passing screenshot, or a plan.
dependency_semantics.development_ready: Requires native functional/software/failure-path evidence for the dependent task, integrator signoff and a list of unresolved external hardware/OS/signing gates. Never means qualified, fully complete or releasable.
dependency_semantics.distribution: All applicable platform, signing, rights, hardware and individual feature tests plus owner authorization are still required. No incomplete task can be advertised as full parity.
